newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor lifts S-E-Banken hold to 5.83pct.
newsitem.headline: Investor lifts S-E-Banken hold to 5.83pct.

text.p: Swedish investment group Investor said on Thursday that it had lifted its stake in S-E-Banken to 5.83 percent from 2.49 percnet.
Investor has bought 17.56 million A series shares in Swedish banking group S-E-Banken since February 14, lifting the total holding to 30.71 million shares, the company said.

Thereby Investor, which is the key holding company in the Wallenberg family's financial empire, holds 6.09 percent of votes and 5.83 percent of capital in the bank, which is considered a Wallenberg family bank.
Previously, Investor held 2.61 percent of votes.
On February 19, 415,109 of the shares were out on loan.
